description: A simple spreadsheet control for Avalonia, with an integrated formula engine and custom function support.
releaseNotes: v1.7.1: Add an icon mode to ButtonCell (ButtonCellMode.Icon), modelled after the RefCell cell body of the SSFinance WPF project: the cell keeps its normal text (editable unless SuppressEdit is set) and a small icon is drawn at the right edge of the cell, vertically centred, with the text area avoiding it; only the icon rectangle is clickable and raises Spreadsheet.CellTapped / CellDoubleTapped, while the rest of the cell behaves like a normal cell. The icon is highlighted on hover (light grey background, darker glyph), the default glyph is the RefCell magnifier and can be replaced through ButtonCell.IconPath (SVG path data); colours are customisable through IconFill / IconHoverFill / IconHoverBackground, and the icon size through IconSize (default 20). v1.7.0: Add a smooth expand / collapse animation for TreeGradeCell rows (Spreadsheet.IsTreeAnimationEnabled, Table.IsTreeAnimationEnabled / TreeAnimationDuration / TreeAnimationMaxRows): when a tree node is toggled, its child rows grow from zero height to their actual height and fade in (or shrink to zero and fade out) driven by a DispatcherTimer that interpolates the row heights at the single source Table.GetHeight, so rendering, headers, hit testing and keyboard navigation all follow the animation; collapsing rows are only added to HiddenRows after they have fully shrunk, the scroll offset is never touched so the viewport stays stable, a re-toggle while an animation is running snaps the previous one to its final state, and animations affecting more than 1000 rows are skipped automatically. v1.6.1: Add frozen rows and columns (Spreadsheet.FrozenRowCount / FrozenColumnCount, FreezePanes / FreezeRows / FreezeColumns / UnfreezePanes): the first n rows and / or columns stay in place at the top / left edge while the rest of the sheet scrolls, separated from the scrollable area by a thicker line; the frozen strips are drawn per quadrant with their own coordinate origin, are skipped by the scroll offset and the scroll-into-view logic, and hitting, selecting, editing, button / link / tree cells and the copy / cut / paste highlight overlay all resolve frozen coordinates correctly. v1.6.0: Add true column hiding (HiddenColumns, SetColumnVisible, SetColumnsVisible, ShowAllColumns, IsColumnHidden, IsColumnVisible, NextVisibleColumn and the Spreadsheet-level HideColumn / ShowColumn / HideRow / ShowRow convenience methods): a hidden column keeps its index but has a width of zero, so its data, header letter, header caption and grid lines disappear and the neighbouring columns are drawn seamlessly next to each other; hidden columns are skipped by rendering, hit testing, keyboard navigation, copy, paste, clear and fill, and are written as hidden Excel columns (XlsxExportOptions.ExportHiddenColumns, false by default). Fix a potential infinite loop in Table.GetRangeX / Table.GetCell when a column has zero width. Add ButtonCell, a clickable button (or underlined link) cell for values that are chosen from an external dialog instead of being typed (e.g. auxiliary accounting items): clicking it raises the new Spreadsheet.CellTapped / CellDoubleTapped events carrying the column, the row, the ButtonCell itself plus its CellType and Tag; while SuppressEdit is set (the default) double clicking, typing, F2 and Backspace do not open the editing box, and the chosen value is written back through Data which repaints the cell. v1.5.0: Add TreeGradeCell (account-tree cell with dotted guide lines and a +/- toggle box) together with the row-visibility infrastructure it needs (HiddenRows, SetRowVisible, ShowAllRows, IsRowVisible, NextVisibleRow, MoveVisibleRows): collapsed rows keep their index but occupy no vertical space and are skipped by rendering, hit testing, keyboard navigation, copy, paste, clear and fill. Clicking the toggle box raises the new Spreadsheet.TreeExpand event; with AutoManageRows (default true) the control also collapses / expands the rows below according to the node levels, otherwise the host does it through SetRowVisible. Add NumericCell (thousand separators, fixed decimals, zero as empty, optional red strikethrough / negative red) with commit-time validation: invalid input is rejected, the cell keeps its value, nothing is pushed onto the Undo stack and the new Spreadsheet.InvalidInput event is raised; NumericLinkCell now shares the same formatter. Add read-only ranges (SetRangeReadonly / IsCellReadonly / ReadonlyRanges) that block editing, pasting and clearing but still allow selecting and copying. Add the Spreadsheet.CellEditEnded event, raised after the data has been written (or after Escape / a rejected input) so hosts can recalculate dependent cells. Numeric cells are exported as real Excel numbers and collapsed rows are hidden in the exported sheet (XlsxExportOptions.ExportHiddenRows). v1.4.0: Export the spreadsheet to Excel .xlsx through the new SaveXlsx method (XlsxExporter + XlsxExportOptions): TitleCells become editable multi-line rich text runs; LinkCells become plain text (optionally with a real Excel hyperlink via ExportLinkAsHyperlink); formulas are kept when they are Excel-compatible (AVG is translated to AVERAGE) and replaced by their cached value otherwise; column widths, row heights, merged ranges, background fills, borders, fonts and text alignment are preserved. v1.3.0: Add LinkCell and NumericLinkCell, custom clickable hyperlink cells rendered instead of the regular text (three-state colours: link / pressed / visited, optional strikethrough, hit-testing cached during render); NumericLinkCell formats amounts with thousands separators and configurable decimals, renders zero values as empty (or "..." with ResponseEmpty); hovering shows a hand cursor, clicking (mouse press+release or Space while selected) raises the new Spreadsheet.LinkClick event carrying column, row and LinkPara; exposed through Table.LinkCells / RgfData.LinkCells / SpreadsheetControl.LinkCells, supported inside merged ranges. v1.2.0: Add TitleCell, a custom cell type for multi-chunk report captions (e.g. a title line followed by a subtitle line), exposed through Table.TitleCells / RgfData.TitleCells / SpreadsheetControl.TitleCells and rendered inside merged ranges; harden TitleCell font resolution so unresolvable font names or default (uninitialised) Typefaces fall back to the default font instead of throwing a NullReferenceException during layout. v1.1.3: Fix explicit border rendering off-by-one at the right/bottom edge of the viewport; clear cached formula results when loading RGF documents; refine ReoGrid v3 RGF parsing (v-border pos handling, style inheritance, font-size pt to DIP conversion, bold-only styles).
